caseName: Detroit Edison Co. v. Securities & Exchange Commission
caseNameFull: Detroit Edison Co. v. Securities & Exchange Commission
attorneys: Messrs. John Foster Dulles and Oscar C. Hull for petitioner. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy and Messrs. Arnold Raum, Chester T. Lane, Christopher M. Jenks, Lawrence S. Lesser, J. Leonard Townsend, and Homer Kripke for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.

The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice Douglas, and Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
